contents:
title: Use bar charts for comparing quantitative values across nominal categories when cardinality is manageable.
corpus_type: design_constraint
source: draco_compassql
quality_tier: gold
mark_type: bar
chart_pattern: bar_chart
task_type: comparison
field_roles: {"x": "nominal", "y": "quantitative"}
required_channels: x, y
transforms: {'type': 'aggregate', 'operation': 'sum_or_mean', 'field_role': 'quantitative'}
negative_conditions: avoid_bar_chart_when_nominal_cardinality_is_too_high, avoid_bar_chart_for_two_quantitative_relationship
query_variants: compare categories by numeric value, bar chart design rule, nominal quantitative comparison

title: Use point or circle marks when the task is to inspect relationships between two quantitative fields.
corpus_type: design_constraint
source: draco_compassql
quality_tier: gold
mark_type: point
chart_pattern: scatter_plot
task_type: relationship
field_roles: {"x": "quantitative", "y": "quantitative"}
required_channels: x, y
negative_conditions: avoid_if_less_than_two_quantitative_fields
query_variants: relationship between two measures, scatter plot recommendation, two quantitative fields

title: Use a histogram only when a quantitative field is available and the task is distribution analysis.
corpus_type: design_constraint
source: draco_compassql
quality_tier: gold
mark_type: bar
chart_pattern: histogram
task_type: distribution
field_roles: {"x": "quantitative"}
required_channels: x
transforms: {'type': 'bin', 'field_role': 'quantitative'}, {'type': 'aggregate', 'operation': 'count'}
negative_conditions: avoid_histogram_for_nominal_only_data
query_variants: histogram requires quantitative field, distribution chart constraint, numeric distribution design rule
